sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Members Management module hotel ke loyalty/club membership program ka system hai — members register karna, unhe smart card dena, card me recharge/load karna, aur membership facilities (restaurant discount, room discount) dena.

MEMBER FLOW: Category banao (Silver/Gold/Platinum) → Member register karo → Smart Card initialize + issue → Card recharge → Member property me aaye to card se bill/pay karo → Reward points accumulate.

rows: Card Initialization, Card Registration, Card Recharge, Card Refund

subsections.title: 2.1 Member Category
subsections.paragraph: Membership tiers define karo — fees, validity, discounts (room/F&B), reward point earning rate. Har category ke benefits alag ho sakte hain.

subsections.title: 2.2 Member Master
subsections.paragraph: Member ka record — personal details, membership no., category, validity, family members, photo. Facility master me member ke available facilities define hote hain.

subsections.title: 3.1 Card Initialization
subsections.paragraph: Naye blank cards system me register karo — card number/serial. Ye inventory of cards hai jo issue honge.

subsections.title: 3.2 Card Registration (Issue to Member)
subsections.paragraph: Card ko member se link karo — member select karo, card serial assign karo. Ab member is card se identify hoga aur POS/Front Office me discount/points milega.
steps: Activate — card member ke naam pe live

subsections.title: 3.3 Card Recharge & Refund
subsections.navPath: Smart Card ▶ Card Recharge / Card Refund
subsections.paragraph: Prepaid cards pe amount load karo (recharge — cash/UPI received). Member card se kharch karta hai — balance deduct hota hai. Membership cancel ho to remaining balance refund (Card Refund screen se). Card Refund screen: membership surrender pe balance refund + card deactivate — audit ke liye refund reason likhna hota hai.
